services.name: Schedule Tour
services.desc: The Oklahoma City Museum of Art offers tours designed for all groups and ages! Visitors will view special exhibitions and the Museum’s permanent collection on all guided or self-guided tours. Self-guided tours are available year-round during regular business hours for groups of 10 or more people. These visits are ideal for groups wanting to explore the Museum’s special exhibitions and permanent collection independently and for teachers wanting to develop discussions and connections between classroom lessons and the Museum’s works of art.
